text:
joel: heads up — noticed a handful of quotas getting charged to `org:unknown` during SA->project proxying. reproducer below, small window but visible in billing dashboards. anyone seen this pattern before?

maria: can you paste the raw request + any auth logs you have?

joel: minimal repro:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sa:eyJhbGci..." \
  -H "X-Forwarded-For: 10.2.3.4" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
```

and service logs show: 
```
authz: resolve_token sa-123 -> principal=service_account:sa-123 project= org=org-456 fallback_origin=none
usage: tokens=12 model=redwood-large cost=0.05
```
(note project= is empty)

sara: that project claim being blank is the smoking gun. looks like the exchange layer is dropping `project` when the token was swapped via proxying-service. possibly an earlier change to the exchange path that normalizes claims.

dan: telemetry schema currently maps attribution like: origin_project ||= request.header[\"X-Org-Project\"] || token.claims.project || org.fallback. if both header + claim absent we default to org. sounds like here the token had project claim but the exchange stripped it. do we have a wire log from the exchange?

joel: attaching small excerpt from exchange stdout (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] exchange: incoming bearer=sa-... mapping path=proxy-svc->auth-exchange
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] exchange: validated sa-123; claims: {"sub":"sa-123","org":"org-456"}
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] exchange: minted proxy token ptk-789 claims: {"sub":"ptk-789","org":"org-456"}
```
notice: minted proxy token lost project claim.

maria: that log implies the original SA token *didn't* have a project claim either — or exchange intentionally omitted it when minting the proxy token. do we know which services call `exchange` and require the project field preserved? billing/quotas definitely do.

sara: our prior policy was to drop resource-scoped claims on proxy tokens for least privilege. but we left a mapping path that copies `x-request-origin` headers to telemetry. some callers rely on the claim instead of header — mismatch.

dan: options: (A) change exchange to copy over `claims.project` into minted token if present (easy), (B) add a mandatory `X-Request-Origin` header at the proxy boundary and teach telemetry to prefer header, (C) map proxy token -> attach an `x-origin-project` metadata blob into the request context (more invasive).

joel: concern with A is accidental privilege escalation if exchange mistakenly copies a project claim that shouldn't be passed to downstream services. but we already copy org and sub.

maria: can we do a conservative two-step: patch exchange to copy project claim only when the caller authenticates as the owner of that project (verify via project registry), otherwise drop it and emit an audit log?

dan: that seems safe. lightweight change: verify project membership via read-only cache (projects service) during exchange. if positive, include `project` in proxy token claims and also set header `X-Origin-Project: proj-123`. telemetry will then use claims.project || header.

sara: also add a sampling debug tag when we see `project` absent so ops can correlate. e.g., `debug.auth.project_missing=true`.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline: auth-exchange v2.41 -> canary cluster alpha-1 at 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z :rocket:

joel: proposed rollout plan: patch -> canary 2% (alpha) -> monitor billing attribution + quota dashboards for 24h -> if stable promote. add alert if any increase in `org:unknown` occurrences.
maria: I'll own the canary run and the telemetry dashboards. I'll add a short eval to compare token.claims.project presence before/after.
dan: i'll draft the minimal exchange change (cache lookup + header emit). sara can you add telemetry mapping change and debug tag?
sara: yep. also adding playbook snippet for ops: if alert fires, revert exchange and flip on header-only mode.

joel: thanks all — file issue and link PRs here and we can sync tomorrow AM. :+1:

maria: created GH issue #4837 and started a PR for exchange patch. linking after CI passes.

infra-bot: GH CI passed for PR #4890 (exchange patch) :white_check_mark:

joel: great, will watch the canary.
